messages:
sara-partnerships: Quick sync — where are we on Qdrant connector certification for Snowflake external functions + Marketplace listing? Need to lock a joint announcement window with Snowflake and Databricks next month.

mike-eng: On the connector side, core work is done. Integration tests pass locally but we need the Snowflake external function packaging and the staged file layout verified. ETA: 5 business days for the certification branch.

jess-marketing: Heads up — if we want a coordinated announcement with Snowflake Marketplace we need the assets (1-pager, joint blog draft, short demo vid). Can we target the week of 2026-04-06 for a soft launch? Need engineering freeze by 2026-04-01.

alan-ux: I'll prep a quick notebook-style demo for Databricks Partner Connect and Snowflake Worksheets showing end-to-end example: ingest vectors -> Redwood API -> Qdrant -> SQL join. Should be a 10–15 min walkthrough.

omri-sales: Snowflake partner team asked for performance numbers on 1M vectors and vector-search latency. Do we have an SLA target to show? They also want a sample TCO comparison vs managed vector DBs.

mike-eng: We have perf runs: median p99 lookup ~42ms for 128-d float32 on A100-like hardware in our test harness. For the Snowflake path (external fn + network hop) we expect ~80-120ms depending on region. I'll dump artifacts to the shared folder.

sara-partnerships: Good. Can you post the perf doc link here when available? Also need to confirm legal / data flow for Snowflake + Qdrant so we can sign the simple partner agreement.

mike-eng: Uploaded perf logs and the test script to the repo. Link: https://git.redwood.dev/qdrant-connector/actions/artifacts/1780 (internal).

deploy-bot: CI passed for branch feature/qdrant-snowflake-cert (build #8421) :white_check_mark:

jess-marketing: Perfect — once we have the artifacts and the notebook, we'll draft co-branded materials. @sara-partnerships can you own outreach to Snowflake partner manager to lock the launch date?

sara-partnerships: On it. I'll ping them today and try to reserve April 8 as tentative. Also will loop in legal for the partner addendum.

alan-ux: Notebook stub ready in PR; sample code snippet below for review:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# make a single call via Snowflake external function
resp = rc.embed_and_store(table='prod_vectors', vector=[0.1,0.2,...])
print(resp)
```

mike-eng: Quick note for packaging: Snowflake expects staged SQL files + a small shim function. Test command I used:
```
docker build -t redwood/qdrant-connector:0.9.1 .
pytest tests/integration/test_snowflake.py::test_external_function -q --maxfail=1
```

omri-sales: If Snowflake gives us a marketplace spot, we should push a joint webinar (30 min) with a partner CS session. Marketing, budget ok?

jess-marketing: Budget approved for joint webinar and paid promo. Need final copy 7 days prior.

sara-partnerships: Great. Plan: engineering certs by 2026-03-30, marketing assets by 2026-04-01, partner outreach this week, tentative launch/announce week of 2026-04-06 (aim for Apr 8). I'll update the partnership tracker. :spiral_calendar:

mike-eng: I'll keep the certification branch green and add the 1M-vector perf fixtures to the artifacts.

deploy-bot: Scheduled nightly perf-run job created: qdrant-cert-nightly (cron: 0 3 * * *)

sara-partnerships: Thanks team — let's reconvene Friday for final readiness. :thumbsup:
